description: Send a bulk campaign again to the recipients whose message is stuck at "sent" — WhatsApp accepted it but it was never confirmed delivered (phone offline, number inactive). Delivered and read recipients are NOT messaged again. Recipients who never got it yet are included. Real WhatsApp messages that Meta charges for, and someone who did receive it without a delivery receipt may get it twice. Requires confirm: call with confirm=false first for a preview (how many people, template, estimated Meta cost), show it to the user, then confirm=true. Needs the Send Bulk add-on. To continue a stopped campaign use resume_campaign; to stop one use cancel_campaign.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to re-send this campaign to every recipient stuck at "sent".

window_ack.description: Required (true) only when the campaign is not an approved template and the workspace uses an official WhatsApp Cloud API number: Meta then delivers it only to contacts who messaged in the last 24 hours. Pass true only after telling the user that.

name: resend_campaign
